intended_object: The canonical S⁻¹R-module structure (with A any localization of R at S) on a module M' that is a localization of the R-module M at S. Inferred from the docstring.
explanation: The definition carries the natural A-module structure on LocalizedModule S M (from LocalizedModule.moduleOfIsLocalization) over to M' along the canonical R-linear isomorphism IsLocalizedModule.iso S f : LocalizedModule S M ≃ M', using AddEquiv.module. This is exactly the standard S⁻¹R-module structure on S⁻¹M, transported to any model M' of the localization. The setting is fully general: a commutative semiring R, any submonoid S, additive commutative monoid modules, and any localization A. No condition is missing and the generality is natural.
